The '''2022–23 Danish Superliga''' (officially the '''3F Superliga''' for sponsorship purposes) was the 33rd season of the [[Danish Superliga]]. [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] were the defending champions. The season began on 15 July 2022 and ended on 9 June 2023.

==Teams==
[[Vejle Boldklub|Vejle]] and [[SønderjyskE Fodbold|SønderjyskE]] finished the [[2021-22 Danish Superliga|2021–22 season]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the [[2022–23 Danish 1st Division|2022–23 1st Division]].

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2021–22 Danish 1st Division|2021–22 1st Division]] Champions [[AC Horsens]] and second place [[Lyngby Boldklub]], who both returned after one season's absence.

==European play-offs==
The 4th-placed team of the championship round advances to a play-off match against the winning team of the qualification round (no. 7) in a single-leg tie, with the team from the championship round as hosts. The winner earns a place in the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League#Second qualifying round|Europa Conference League second qualifying round]].

===European play-off match===
{{Football box
| date         = 9 June 2023
| time         = 19:00
